intelligence.enrichment: Leaves are the primary site of photosynthesis; food prepared in leaves is transported to all parts of the plant through phloem. Photosynthesis in leaves -> food prepared in leaves -> transport through phloem -> food reaches other plant parts. The learner correctly applies this rule: Leaves are the primary site of photosynthesis; food prepared in leaves is transported to all parts of the plant through phloem. Stored starch in roots or potatoes is made there from soil minerals, not transported from leaves.
